links.outcome: AI vs tele-ophthalmologist agreement with glaucoma specialist diagnosis and false-positive referrals
links.effect: AI agreement with specialist 80.3% vs 55.3% for tele-ophthalmologist; false positive referrals 2 of 10 for AI vs 9 of 10 for tele-ophthalmologist.
links.quote: The agreement between AI and the glaucoma specialist was 80.3%, surpassing the 55.3% agreement between the tele-ophthalmologist and the glaucoma specialist amongst those participants who were referred to the base hospital.

screen.reason: Prospective cross-sectional evaluation of an offline AI diagnostic tool embedded in satellite vision centers compared against tele-ophthalmologists and specialists, evaluating diagnostic performance in a live workflow.
